access.limitation: OpenAI describes finite-answer Decisions API classification and routing, but no public callable API reference or Jovie project admission was available for this run.
access.resumeEvent: Resume when OpenAI publishes a callable Decisions API request/response reference and the Jovie project is admitted, with version identity, pricing, usage/provenance, retention and availability terms observable.

evidenceByDimension.taskCorrectnessAndCalibratedAbstention: Deterministic safety floor: macro-F1 0.0236, abstention 100%, false auto-assignment 0%; Jev remains fixture/shadow-only and Decisions is unrun.
evidenceByDimension.falsePositiveAndFalseNegativeCost: Always-abstain prevents false routes but misses every classified task; supplier deltas are unavailable.
evidenceByDimension.latencyAndAvailability: Deterministic baseline is local; Jev live latency is unmeasured; Decisions is limited-preview and unavailable to Jovie.
evidenceByDimension.fullyLoadedCost: Deterministic machine cost is zero, but human handling caused by 100% abstention is unmeasured; live supplier, retry and correction costs are unknown, never treated as zero.
evidenceByDimension.optionSetAndAuthoritySafety: Frozen cluster sets plus abstain remain authoritative; zero/one/deterministic cases permit zero probabilistic calls.
evidenceByDimension.observabilityAndProvenance: Cohort version and digest are pinned; Jev uses existing gateway receipts; Decisions receipt identity is undocumented.
evidenceByDimension.privacyAndDataHandling: Existing sanitized text boundary remains; Decisions retention and data controls for this preview are unverified.
evidenceByDimension.portabilityAndSwitchingCost: Existing provider-neutral replay seam is reusable, but the Decisions wire contract and switching cost are unknown.
evidenceByDimension.downstreamCertifiedOutcome: No executed supplier comparison or certified downstream outcome exists; promotion is inadmissible.

sourcingDecision.expectedEconomics: Retain the zero-cost deterministic/incumbent path until a same-cohort executed comparison measures correction and total workflow cost.
sourcingDecision.dependencyRisk: No Decisions dependency added; Jev stays shadow-only.
sourcingDecision.reversibility: Fully reversible because no production route changes.
sourcingDecision.reEvaluateTrigger: The Decisions resume event occurs or Jev gains authorized same-cohort live evidence.
